title: features.json — machine-readable feature state machine
description: Each feature: behavior (what it does), verification (the command that proves it, shaped to the project kind's real proof surface), state. Builder may set planned/active/blocked/built; only a fresh-context review sets verified. Default 1 UP: at most one feature active.

behavior.description: What it does, as observable behavior — not implementation

verification.description: Command that proves the behavior on the kind's real proof surface (not just 'tests pass')

state.description: planned → active → built → verified → landed. blocked from any working state. Only fresh review sets verified.

blocked_on.description: Required when state=blocked: the exact decision or dependency

verified_by.description: Required when state=verified: reviewer + artifact/evidence pointer (never the builder)
